versions.subject: Merge PR #5716 from @tsale - Add detection rules for abuse of OpenEDR's response feature
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\ITSMService.exe'
    Image|endswith: '\ssh-shellhost.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '--pty'
selection_cli_shell:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'bash'
        - 'cmd'
        - 'powershell'
        - 'pwsh'
condition: all of selection_*
